metrics.label: Prominence
metrics.note: Career standing, era-adjusted so older figures are not buried by modern vote counts.

metrics.label: Typical hit size
metrics.note: Era-adjusted box office per film, so it tracks big films rather than many. 54% of films report revenue.

colorModes.label: Role

colorModes.label: Where they work
colorModes.note: Coloured by where most of their films were made; filtering matches any country they have 3+ films in. Only seven colours stay separable, so the rest share a neutral.

colorModes.label: Era of their career
colorModes.note: The era containing the median year of their filmography.
